project.name: Verdiqt
project.summary: An evidence-first SaaS idea validation cockpit where a person and an agent judge the same live trial together.
project.ai_usage: Planned and being implemented: OpenAI Responses will support citation-backed web research, idea normalization, evidence classification, and schema-validated scoring and verdict rationales. OpenAI embeddings will retrieve original Verdiqt playbook passages from pgvector. Human approvals, evidence controls, citations, and code-enforced limits constrain model use.
project.codex_usage: Codex is the lead build collaborator. It reconciled the founder brief, requirements, architecture, WebMCP contracts, security gates, and implementation plan; scaffolded the pinned application; built and visually checked the first Verdiqt UI; and will implement sequenced slices, tests, deployment checks, and submission preparation.
